en.title: Slavery in Brazil and the world: coercion, political economy, emancipation and historical inequality
en.deck: A transregional study of coercive labor, Atlantic voyages, Brazilian imperial censuses, abolition, long-run property inequality and modern forced labor.
en.regime: Forced labor and its legal abolition left unequal economic and institutional inheritances.
en.key_risk: Treating historical embarkations and modern model estimates as equivalent counts.

pt-BR.title: Escravidão no Brasil e no mundo: economia política da coerção, abolição e desigualdade histórica
pt-BR.deck: Estudo transregional do trabalho coercitivo, tráfico atlântico, censos do Império, abolição, patrimônio desigual e trabalho forçado contemporâneo.

producer_checks.information_cutoff: Historical 1501–1888 record; 2021 global modern slavery estimate published in 2022; documented through 24 October 2026.

producer_checks.visual_signature: Source-based Atlantic carrier embarkation chart, denominators table, causal flow and geographically qualified map in each locale.
producer_checks.source_check: 13 matching institutional and research sources (SlaveVoyages, IBGE, ILO/IOM/Walk Free, UNESCO, US and UK official archives).
